fix: Add the registry and `evolve gc check [--json]` (report, no mutation). Port the worktree sweep as the first check. Change the landing target of mergedBranches and of the apply re-check (deleteBranch and deleteSquashed, go/internal/gc/worktrees.go:610-632) to the fetched origin/main, and delete refs with `update-ref -d <ref> <expected>` in place of `branch -d`. Move gateLeftovers out of the dev sweep (go/internal/gc/devleftovers.go:40) into a function that a cycle-tree check can call. An adapter keeps the current stage of the sweep.
summary: Plan PR #1585, decisions D4, D10, D11, components X1a. Each check is an adapter: Scan calls the existing Plan, the justification reads its Rule or Reason, and Apply calls the existing Apply. The sealed sweep judges landed against the hub HEAD (go/internal/gc/worktrees.go:267, :285), which can hold an unpushed integration merge.
title: A gc check registry with `evolve gc check`, first for the worktree sweep, with the origin/main landing target
